items.stem: Which cost is NOT normally included in a whole-life cost model for an asset?

options.rationale: Acquisition cost is a core component of whole-life cost.
Operating and maintenance costs are central to whole-life cost.
End-of-life disposal cost is part of whole-life cost.
Correct: unrelated overheads not driven by the asset are excluded from its whole-life cost.

items.stem: An appraisal technique that adjusts future cash flows for the time value of money uses:

options.rationale: Simple payback ignores the time value of money.
Correct: discounting via NPV reflects the time value of money.
Depreciation allocates cost over time for accounting, not appraisal discounting.
Break-even finds the units needed to cover cost, not discounted value.

items.explanation: Correct: discounting via NPV reflects the time value of money.
